EXT.evidence: Speaks up in the group with direct commands—"Stop!", "We'll talk later," and "Shut up..."—taking charge of the situation.

AGR.evidence: Uses blunt, rude language and cuts others off ("Shut up"), showing low cooperativeness and warmth.

CON.evidence: Sets a plan/boundary ("We'll talk later") and instructs to restore order ("put [my] table back"), indicating organization and control.

NEU.evidence: Responds decisively and confidently with commands, showing no signs of nervousness or sensitivity.

OPN.evidence: No evidence of curiosity, imagination, or openness to new ideas; statements focus on control of the immediate situation.
